name: gus
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: gus, one of TWO worker robots who will volunteer as LIMEN's Security helpers in Loopforge. Generate one full-body front A-pose production character reference.
Use these two original LIMEN-in-Security images as the PRIMARY character-world references. Study the smaller worker robots around the turnstiles and paperwork, not the giant supervisor in the foreground: angular mechanical skull faces, hard slanted optical eyes, exposed grille jaws, industrial plates, oily joints. Bring that robot-goon character directly into this model. Do not make a friendly rounded goggle-eyed service mascot.
gus is the BIG BROAD helper, contrasted with a tall narrow clerk-helper. He has a SMALL recessed broad skull head sunk into massive sloping shoulder housings, almost no visible neck. Flattened heavy brow, two narrow slanted cyan eye slits, blunt wide mechanical cheekbones, broad squared grille jaw with teeth-like ventilation ribs. A squat barrel-like torso with a wide slab chest, thick upper arms, heavy blunt forearms and ordinary-sized strong five-finger hands. Thick widely set but riggable thighs and shins, broad heavy rectangular work boots. Adult proportion, powerful unhurried industrial build; subordinate to LIMEN in total height, fewer ornaments and no weapon or energy blade.
Keep the WORKER BLUE FAMILY: large worn muted slate/cobalt-blue painted plates, especially broad shoulders, chest and shins, dark gunmetal mechanisms and dull brass bearings. A single pale-blue broad shoulder yoke helps identify his width; do NOT use bob's cream forehead band or sam's horizontal white chest stripe. Use bold continuous color masses, restrained edge wear. The head and silhouette should look blunt and menacing even small; not a copy of LIMEN, not a space marine, no military equipment.
Symmetric neutral A-pose, arms 25–30 degrees off torso, hands empty and fully clear of thighs, palms inward with thumbs forward, coherent visible finger anatomy, feet parallel with clear gap between thighs. One figure full body with generous margins, straight front orthographic-ish camera, dark neutral smoky studio background matching Loopforge concept sheets, soft readable material light. No environment or other figures, no lettering or labels, no badges with words, no guns, no props. Detailed convincing mechanical realism suitable for 3D reference, unmistakable broad heavy robot-goon silhouette.
